right.raw_text: - Underlying severe congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association (NYHA) IV), severe COPD (need for chronic oxygen or mechanical ventilation), severe liver disease (Child-Pugh Class C), cancer requiring chemotherapy, or transplantation (bone marrow, heart, lung, liver, pancreas, or small bowel) in the past 6 months or likely within the next 6 months
- Previous episode of sepsis during that hospital admission

left.raw_text: - Treating physician deems aggressive care unsuitable (i.e. no commitment to active care)
- Participation in another interventional drug study within previous 1 month
- Allergic to the study drug or any of its components

right.raw_text: - Have signed a Do No Resuscitate (DNR) Form
